explication: Squad is a human-led multi-agent development product for GitHub Copilot. The documented path is to initialize a project team, propose and confirm agents, then direct work through Copilot, where requests are routed to specialists whose knowledge and decisions persist in project state. The repository also includes issue triage, platform integrations, plugins, team sharing, remote control, and a .NET adapter. The README establishes the user workflow; sampled source confirms casting and storage behavior, but does not expose enough call sites to assert all subsystem wiring.
